entries.description: Auto mode's main-session consecutive-denial prompt auto-denies after a timeout (default 120000 ms) instead of waiting forever.
Auto mode escalates to a blocking prompt after 3 consecutive or 20 total classifier denials.
entries.relied_by: never-halt hooks (Decisions 10, 15): BpHook::DenialBreaker trips at $MAX_CONSECUTIVE=2 / $MAX_TOTAL=17, one below these limits ($AUTO_MODE_MAX_CONSECUTIVE / $AUTO_MODE_MAX_TOTAL)

entries.description: A subagent at its denial limit aborts with "too many classifier denials".
entries.relied_by: never-halt hooks (Decision 10): subagent abort at the denial limit

entries.description: The disableAgentView setting gates the agent view off.
The disableWorkflows setting gates the Workflows feature off.
Auto mode skips the classifier for a tool on its static safe allowlist, logging that it is on the safe allowlist.
entries.relied_by: never-halt hooks (Decision 15): BpHook::DenialBreaker's @CLASSIFIER_EXEMPT_TOOLS mirrors this allowlist (F3)

entries.description: A Bash permissions.allow rule body ending " *" also matches the command with that trailing word omitted.
PostToolUseFailure fires only after a tool call has started running, never for a permission denial.
entries.relied_by: never-halt hooks (Decision 15): BpHook::DenialBreaker registers on PostToolUseFailure to reset its mirror (F5)
